moments.title: Community Shield Showdown
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield will see Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup holders Manchester City at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on August 16th.

angles.name: Match Hype
angles.copy: Cardiff is gearing up for a massive one! The Community Shield kicks off on August 16th as Arsenal face Manchester City. Who's taking the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Local Buzz Cardiff
angles.copy: Principality Stadium is hosting the Community Shield! Get ready Cardiff, Arsenal vs Man City is coming to town on August 16th. Big game vibes for the capital!

moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Action
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are deep into their pre-season preparations with friendlies taking place globally and at home, ahead of the new season starting August 21st.

angles.name: Pre-Season Buzz
angles.copy: The new Premier League season is just weeks away! Who are you most excited to see in pre-season action?

angles.name: Club Focus
angles.copy: Chelsea are facing Juventus in a friendly on August 5th, while Man Utd take on PSG on August 8th. Pre-season is getting serious!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival

angles.name: Fringe is ON

angles.name: Scotland Calling
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is bringing incredible talent to our doorstep throughout August. What shows are on your must-see list?

moments.title: James Hetfield's Birthday
moments.blurb: Metallica frontman James Hetfield turns 63 today, August 3rd. He co-founded the legendary heavy metal band in 1981 and is celebrated for his powerful vocals and influential guitar work.

source.l: This Day In Music / Bored Panda

angles.name: Rock Icon Turns
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only James Hetfield! The Metallica frontman is still bringing the thunder. What's your favourite Metallica track?

angles.name: Legendary Vocals
angles.copy: From 'Enter Sandman' to 'Master of Puppets', James Hetfield's voice defined a generation. Celebrating his 63rd birthday today!

moments.title: Beverly Lee's Birthday

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 95th birthday to Beverly Lee of The Shirelles! Her voice on 'Will You Love Me Tomorrow' is timeless. What a legend!

angles.name: Music Pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating Beverly Lee of The Shirelles, who turns 95 today! A true pioneer of girl group sound. What's your favourite Shirelles hit?
